name: Kim'jael Indeed!
summary: Kim'jael asks you to search Thalassian Base Camp for four belongings. You are to bring them back to him in Azshara.

sections.title: At the Camp
sections.body: Kim'jael is waiting in Azshara, and his belongings are at Thalassian Base Camp. You are asked to find his compass, scope, stuffed chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him.

faq.q: What does Kim'jael want me to find?
faq.answer: Kim'jael asks you to find his compass, scope, stuffed chicken and Wizzlegoober at Thalassian Base Camp.
Kim'jael's compass, scope, stuffed chicken and Wizzlegoober are at Thalassian Base Camp.
